findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - stopping a review on Windows from a virtual environment.
The test is marked for Windows, but `.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:81` runs the Windows matrix only on a schedule or manual dispatch, while the pull request tests run on Linux at `.github/workflows/forge.yml:61`. The recorded Windows dispatch, 45055052826, failed the CI-wait upgrade test, and the supplied evidence gives no successful Windows run for the current revision. A completed passing Windows run or a pull request check is still needed to establish the lifecycle proof for this revision.
